name: stay-human

commands.capabilities: discover this interface without network or credentials
commands.list: return only id, category, status and summary; no full recipes
commands.show <recipe-id>: requirements only; no guide, sourcing or reports
commands.plan <recipe-id> --country <CC> --city <: return adaptation inputs and unresolved checks; no buying or live search
commands.init recipe --id <recipe-id> [--write]: preview or create a new experimental recipe
commands.init sourcing --recipe <recipe-id> --id: preview or create an unverified local sourcing variant
commands.init report --recipe <recipe-id> --id <r: preview or create a structured draft build report
commands.validate: check local structured content and evidence references
commands.show <recipe-id> --section sourcing [--c: load only relevant local product records
commands.show <recipe-id> --section guide: optional prose, never loaded by default

writes: local init only, opt-in --write, no overwrite; all other commands read-only
network: none; git hosting and product research are separate, explicitly controlled steps
identity: recipe id remains stable; pin a git commit for reproducibility
contribution: fork -> branch -> init/edit -> validate -> tests -> review diff -> commit -> push -> pull request -> maintainer review
context: progressive disclosure; compact JSON; never recursively ingest the repository
